ant.definition: A small insect with six legs that lives in organised groups.
ant.exampleUsage: The ant was identified during the lesson.

bee.definition: A flying insect that collects nectar and makes honey.
bee.exampleUsage: The bee was identified during the lesson.

butterfly.definition: A flying insect with colourful wings.
butterfly.exampleUsage: The butterfly was identified during the lesson.

ladybug.definition: A small red or black insect with spots on its back.
ladybug.exampleUsage: The ladybug was identified during the lesson.

dragonfly.definition: A flying insect with a long body and two pairs of wings.
dragonfly.exampleUsage: The dragonfly was identified during the lesson.

grasshopper.definition: A jumping insect with long back legs that eats plants.
grasshopper.exampleUsage: The grasshopper was identified during the lesson.

beetle.definition: To fly or go in a manner resembling a beetle.

fly.definition: An insect with one pair of wings and large eyes.

mosquito.definition: Two-winged insect whose female has a long proboscis to pierce the skin and suck the blood of humans and animals.
mosquito.exampleUsage: The mosquito was identified during the lesson.

cricket.exampleUsage: The cricket was identified during the lesson.
cricket.definition: An insect known for the chirping sound made by its wings.

wing.definition: A group within a political party or legislature or other organization that holds distinct views or has a particular function.

antenna.definition: A device that sends or receives radio and television signals.
antenna.exampleUsage: The antenna was used during the activity.

leg.definition: A structure in animals that is similar to a human leg and used for locomotion.
leg.exampleUsage: The leg was identified during the lesson.

thorax.definition: The middle region of the body of an arthropod between the head and the abdomen.

abdomen.definition: The region of the body of a vertebrate between the thorax and the pelvis.

head.definition: The upper part of the human body or the front part of the body in animals.
head.exampleUsage: The head was identified during the lesson.

eye.definition: Good discernment (either visually or as if visually).

mandible.definition: The jaw in vertebrates that is hinged to open the mouth.

stinger.definition: A sharp organ of offense or defense (as of a wasp or stingray or scorpion) often connected with a poison gland.

proboscis.definition: The human nose (especially when it is large).

hive.definition: To move together in a hive or as if in a hive.

anthill.definition: A mound of earth made by ants as they dig their nest.

web.definition: An intricate network suggesting something that was formed by weaving or interweaving.

cocoon.definition: To retreat as if into a cocoon, as from an unfriendly environment.

burrow.definition: To move through by or as by digging.

leaf.definition: A flat green part of a plant that uses light to make food.

bark.definition: The rough outer covering of a tree trunk.

soil.definition: Material in the top layer of the surface of the earth in which plants can grow (especially with reference to its quality or use).

pond-surface.definition: The topmost layer of a pond is the boundary where its water meets the air.
pond-surface.arabicTranslation: كائن أو عنصر طبيعي يُسمّى «بوند سورفاكي»

larva.definition: The immature free-living form of most invertebrates and amphibians and fish which at hatching from the egg is fundamentally unlike its parent and must metamorphose.
larva.exampleUsage: The larva was identified during the lesson.

caterpillar.definition: A young insect that looks like a worm before becoming a butterfly or moth.
caterpillar.exampleUsage: The caterpillar was identified during the lesson.

pupa.definition: An insect in the inactive stage of development (when it is not feeding) intermediate between larva and adult.
pupa.exampleUsage: The pupa was identified during the lesson.

chrysalis.definition: Pupa of a moth or butterfly enclosed in a cocoon.

metamorphosis.definition: The marked and rapid transformation of a larva into an adult that occurs in some animals.
metamorphosis.exampleUsage: The metamorphosis was identified during the lesson.

molt.definition: Periodic shedding of the cuticle in arthropods or the outer skin in reptiles.
molt.exampleUsage: The molt was identified during the lesson.

nymph.definition: A larva of an insect with incomplete metamorphosis (as the dragonfly or mayfly).
nymph.exampleUsage: The nymph was identified during the lesson.

adult.exampleUsage: The adult was identified during the lesson.

swarm.definition: A group of many things in the air or on the ground.

sting.definition: A sharp painful injury caused by an insect or animal.

crawl.definition: To move forward close to the ground on hands, knees, or legs.

buzz.definition: To make a low humming sound, like a flying insect.

dig.definition: To turn up, loosen, or remove earth.

spin.definition: To form a web by making a thread.

camouflage.definition: An outward semblance that misrepresents the true nature of something.

hibernate.definition: To spend the winter in a state of greatly reduced activity.

earthworm.definition: Terrestrial worm that burrows into and helps aerate soil.

snail.definition: A small slow-moving animal with a spiral shell.
snail.exampleUsage: The snail was identified during the lesson.

slug.definition: An amount of an alcoholic drink (usually liquor) that is poured or gulped.

centipede.definition: Chiefly nocturnal predacious arthropod having a flattened body of 15 to 173 segments each with a pair of legs, the foremost pair being modified as prehensors.

millipede.definition: Any of numerous herbivorous nonpoisonous arthropods having a cylindrical body of 20 to 100 or more segments most with two pairs of legs.

aphid.definition: Any of various small plant-sucking insects.
aphid.exampleUsage: The aphid was identified during the lesson.

praying-mantis.definition: A predatory insect with a long body and large front legs held in a folded position that resembles hands in prayer.
praying-mantis.exampleUsage: A praying mantis waited motionless on a leaf.

firefly.definition: Tropical American click beetle having bright luminous spots.

moth.definition: Typically crepuscular or nocturnal insect having a stout body and feathery or hairlike antennae.
moth.exampleUsage: The moth was identified during the lesson.

wasp.definition: Social or solitary hymenopterans typically having a slender body with the abdomen attached by a narrow stalk and having a formidable sting.
